name: BsFrameStep
meaning: what BsFile's frame walk returns: NextFrame, FirstFrame, SeekFrameOfType, FindFrameOfType (engine/bs_file.cpp; returned as int)

name: BSFRAME_NOT_OPEN
meaning: the file is not open (ok != 1): nothing moved

name: BSFRAME_NEXT
meaning: moved on to the next frame

name: BSFRAME_FIRST
meaning: at frame 0: FirstFrame's result and NextFrame's when it wraps past the last frame
